python -c "
# Check challenge system: all exercise slugs in PAID_POOL exist in EXERCISES
# Read the challenge file and data.ts exports
import re

with open(r'src/exercises/challenges.ts', 'r') as f:
    challenges = f.read()
with open(r'src/exercises/data.ts', 'r') as f:
    data = f.read()

# Extract PAID_POOL
paid = re.findall(r\"'([a-z0-9-]+)'\", challenges.split('PAID_POOL')[1].split('];')[0])
# Extract all EXERCISES slugs
slugs = re.findall(r\"slug: '([a-z0-9-]+)'\", data)

for p in paid:
    if p not in slugs:
        print(f'MISSING EXERCISE: {p}')
    else:
        print(f'OK: {p}')
        
print()
print(f'Total exercises: {len(slugs)}')
print(f'Paid pool: {paid}')
"
